doc: One row of u = s - t sweeping -3e38 .. 3e38 through every regime (clear air below -1.6, the cumulus window, the shield ramp 0.5 +- 0.175, overcast), for fine = -1, 0, +1 (three rows), t = 0 as a python float: float32 chain, overflow of u / 0.35 to infinity at +-3e38 clipped to exactly 0 and 1. No streak, no subtexel. Tolerance is the golden float32 default. Arguments: s, fine, t, streak and subtexel are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted t, streak (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads (the others keep their defaults). params.result_dtype ("f64" or "f32") is the dtype numpy gives the result by promotion (a float64 t array or float64 inputs give f64, a python-float t with float32 fields keeps f32); it is informational, the stored output has that dtype. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 1.1e-7; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 2.4e-7 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is 23x the larger of the two spreads.
